g.text: Training partition and offline graph partition are distinct mechanisms; neither implies spontaneous expert motion.

text.style: font-size: 6.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #617080

g.text: The locality objective encourages reuse of expert pages across tokens and recurrent dispatches; no speedup is asserted.
